title: Soundness error lies in the unit interval
statement: For all real numbers $\mathrm{noise}$ and $\varepsilon$, if $0\leq\varepsilon\leq1$, then the soundness error—equal to $\sqrt{\varepsilon}/2$ when $\varepsilon\leq\mathrm{noise}$ and to $1/2$ otherwise—lies in $[0,1]$.
